name: dash-frontend
description: Frontend application for the DASH platform
author: Francisco Aranda <farandal@gmail.com>

scripts._CONFIG: CONFIG, set build config variables by setting the CUSTOM_MODE (.env.{CUSTOM_MODE}), TARGET_TYPE ['mobile', 'desktop', 'web'] and PLATFORM ['android', 'ios', 'web', 'electron']
scripts.config:web:kitchntabs:production: MODE=production CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.production TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web  node build_config.js
scripts.config:web:kitchntabs:development: MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.development TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web  node build_config.js
scripts.config:web:kitchntabs:local: MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.local TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web  node build_config.js
scripts.config:electron:kitchntabs:production: MODE=production CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.production TARGET_TYPE=desktop PLATFORM=electron  node build_config.js
scripts.config:electron:kitchntabs:development: MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.development TARGET_TYPE=desktop PLATFORM=electron  node build_config.js
scripts.config:android:kitchntabs:production: MODE=production CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.production TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=android node build_config.js
scripts.config:android:kitchntabs:development: MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.development TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=android node build_config.js
scripts.config:ios:kitchntabs:production: MODE=production CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.production TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=ios node build_config.js
scripts.config:ios:kitchntabs:development: MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.development TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=ios node build_config.js
scripts._DEV: DEV, the domain dev script will take the config generated by the parent script.
scripts.dev:electron:kitchntabs:development: pnpm config:electron:kitchntabs:development && vite build -c electron.vite.config.mts && cross-env NODE_ENV=development BUILD_ENV=dev CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.development concurrently "pnpm dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3006 && electron ."
scripts.dev:electron:kitchntabs:production: pnpm config:electron:kitchntabs:production && vite build -c electron.vite.config.mts && cross-env NODE_ENV=development BUILD_ENV=dev CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.production concurrently "pnpm dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3006 && electron ."
scripts.dev:android:kitchntabs:development: cross-env MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.development TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=android NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js && turbo build --no-cache && cap run android
scripts.dev:android:kitchntabs:production: cross-env MODE=production CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.production TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=android NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js && turbo build --no-cache && cap run android
scripts.release:android:kitchntabs:development: pnpm config:electron:kitchntabs:development && turbo build --no-cache && cap sync android && cd ./android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.release:android:kitchntabs:production: pnpm config:electron:kitchntabs:production && turbo build --no-cache && cap sync android && cd ./android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.release:electron:kitchntabs:production: pnpm config:electron:kitchntabs:production && node build-python-service.js && electron-icon-builder --input=./apps/dash/src/assets/logo-squared.png --output=./ && vite build -c electron.vite.config.mts && turbo build --no-cache && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8096 node build-electron.js --config electron-builder.config.js
